classification.note: no claim in this ledger names a risk surface or a risk term, so the security lane is empty. That is a measurement about this corpus, not a statement that it is safe.
classification.policy: A claim is in the security lane when the source text at its anchor — the file path, the provider member or the line itself — names one of the risk categories. A lane claim is canonised only with a human authority record naming a stable role, team or council identifier, and a falsification plan that observes behaviour rather than re-reading the text. A claim the classifier cannot settle is reported, never placed in the ordinary lane.
